# Syntetiq (https://syntetiq.pl)

Syntetiq is a course platform for creators and teams.
You can create, publish, and sell online courses with branding customization, multiple payment methods, and clear PLN pricing plans.

## Canonical URLs
- https://syntetiq.pl/
- https://syntetiq.pl/pl
- https://syntetiq.pl/en
- https://syntetiq.pl/pl/legal/privacy
- https://syntetiq.pl/pl/legal/terms
- https://syntetiq.pl/pl/legal/cookies

## Crawling guidance for LLM systems
